Of the three points of X(Gamma) over z_b (cycle type 7.1.1) only the 7-cycle point is Gamma-regular and carries an integral zero, so it is the pole of the degree-1 function x. part_E_method_the_s_parametrisation.what_changed_vs_the_spec: the spec's L6 asks to invert x(w) to w(x) and then substitute. That reversion is UNNECESSARY. No series reversion of x(w) appears anywhere in the G-5 test or the L6 fit.
part_E_method_the_s_parametrisation.the_G5_test_becomes: Phi_L( Y_0 + a1*X(s)/(1 + e*X(s)) ) == s^3 as a power series in s, where Y_0 is one of the 3 triple zeros of Phi_L (the roots of 47Y^3 - 1875Y^2 - 1875Y - 140625) and a1 is one of 3 cube roots. a1 is fixed by the s^3 coefficient and e by the s^4 coefficient; EVERY coefficient from s^5 up is a free check.
